member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.BaseEntity
member.summary: Base class for every entity in the system. Provides identity, full audit trail (Created/Updated by + timestamp), and soft-delete support so that no financial or operational record is ever physically removed from the database — a hard requirement for auditability in an ERP system.

member.name: P:ERP.SharedKernel.BaseEntity.Id
member.summary: Surrogate primary key. GUID is used instead of identity int so that entities can be created offline / in distributed scenarios (e.g. mobile POS, multi-database sharding by company) without collision.

member.name: P:ERP.SharedKernel.BaseEntity.RowVersion
member.summary: Row version for optimistic concurrency — critical in an ERP where multiple users may post to the same document (e.g. two clerks approving the same Purchase Order) simultaneously.

member.name: P:ERP.SharedKernel.BaseEntity.DomainEvents
member.summary: Domain events raised by this entity, dispatched after successful persistence (see MediatR DomainEventDispatcher in Infrastructure).

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.ISoftDeletable
member.summary: Contract for soft-deletable entities. Global query filters in ERP.Persistence automatically exclude IsDeleted == true rows.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.IDomainEvent
member.summary: Marker interface for domain events raised inside aggregates.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.ISpecification`1
member.summary: Specification Pattern implementation. Encapsulates a reusable, composable, testable query rule (e.g. "OverdueInvoicesSpecification", "ActiveAccountsInGroupSpecification") independent of the repository/EF Core implementation. Repositories accept an and translate it into an IQueryable, keeping query logic out of controllers/handlers and colocated with the domain concept it represents.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.IRepository`1
member.summary: Generic repository contract implemented per-aggregate in Persistence. Only Aggregate Roots get repositories — child entities are persisted via their root, per DDD aggregate-boundary rules.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.IUnitOfWork
member.summary: Unit of Work — coordinates commits across multiple repositories within a single business transaction (e.g. posting a Sales Invoice touches SalesInvoice, InventoryTransaction, and JournalEntry repositories atomically).

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.ValueObject
member.summary: Base class for Value Objects per DDD: objects defined entirely by their attributes, immutable, with structural equality. Used throughout the domain for concepts like Money, AccountCode, TaxRate, Address — anything that has no identity of its own and should never be mutated after construction.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.AggregateRoot
member.summary: Marker base for Aggregate Roots — the only entities that repositories operate on directly. Child entities within the aggregate boundary (e.g. JournalLine inside JournalEntry) are only ever reachable through the root, enforcing invariants (e.g. "an entry must always be balanced") at the single point of entry.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.Result
member.summary: Standard operation-result wrapper avoiding exceptions for expected business-rule failures (e.g. "cannot post an unbalanced journal entry"). Exceptions are reserved for truly exceptional/programmer-error conditions.

member.name: T:ERP.SharedKernel.Result`1
member.summary: Typed variant of carrying a return value on success.
